tracks.title: Sunny Day (Intro)

neurological_impact.mechanism: Acoustic Entrainment (96 BPM) to synchronize heart rate variability and down-regulate sympathetic nervous system activity.
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Prepares auditory processing centers for receptive language; reduces transition anxiety into morning circle time.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: Morning arrival anchor ritual; replaces shouting or visual digital noise with calming acoustic resonance.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: 10-min sunlight stretch: Children hold warm polished stones while synchronizing deep breaths with the guitar pulse.

tracks.title: Days of the Week

neurological_impact.mechanism: Sequential Auditory Memory encoding via 7-beat melodic loop anchoring temporal cyclical structures in hippocampus.
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Builds chronological ordering, past/present/future conceptualization, and verbal sequencing stamina.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: Daily calendar transition; replaces rote drill cards with an embodied 7-step rhythmic cadence.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: 7-stone day path: Children physically step or hop across 7 numbered floor tiles matching the sung cadence.

tracks.title: Alphabet Song Remix

neurological_impact.mechanism: Phonemic segmentation breakdown (A-A-A, B-B-B) isolating individual phonemes to sharpen auditory cortical discrimination.
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Prevents the 'L-M-N-O-P' blur; primes vocal articulators for reading readiness and letter-sound correspondence.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: Core phonemic awareness drill; screen-free letter recognition with clapping staccato accents.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: Sandpaper letter tracing: Children trace tactile letter cards with index finger in sync with the staccato triplets.

tracks.title: Horses Interlude

neurological_impact.mechanism: Cognitive dissonance resolution through playful non-examples (donkey, pig, sheep, cat) stimulating executive categorization.
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Enhances selective auditory attention, taxonomic sorting, and humor-driven cognitive engagement.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: Living systems animal classification game; sparks verbal reasoning during circle time discussions.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: Animal figurine sorting: Children sort miniature animals into 'Horse' vs 'Not a Horse' baskets upon hearing dialogue cues.

tracks.title: Le Cheval

neurological_impact.mechanism: Foreign phonemic mapping expanding phonetic perceptual boundaries before the synaptogenesis pruning window closes (~age 7).
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Instills native-like ear for French vowel nasals and cadences; builds cognitive flexibility and global empathy.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: Multilingual circle time; children embody French gait terminology (marche, trot, galop) through movement.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: Equestrian gait ribbons: Children wave silk ribbons in high, medium, and fast arcs matching 'marche, trot, galop'.

tracks.title: Let's Stretch

neurological_impact.mechanism: Vestibular stimulation and bilateral midline crossing activating the corpus callosum for hemisphere integration.
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Enhances proprioceptive feedback, spinal elongation, diaphragmatic lung capacity, and stress reduction.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: Pre-seatwork motor primer; grounds restless energy before writing or focused reading blocks.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: Toe-touch cloud reach: Children pair nasal inhalation with vertical reaching and mouth exhalation with floor tapping.

tracks.title: Drill Time

neurological_impact.mechanism: Contralateral locomotor march and cross-lateral limb isolation stimulating motor cortex cerebellar pathways.
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Develops left/right bodily differentiation, auditory-motor reaction timing, and aerobic stamina.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: High-energy reset ritual; channels active physical excitement into disciplined, joyful coordination.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: Knuckle-step cadence: Children march in rhythm while tapping alternating opposite knees (left hand to right knee).

tracks.title: Numbers

neurological_impact.mechanism: Kinesthetic-Auditory 1-to-1 Correspondence: associating discrete motor claps with verbalized numerical symbols.
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Solidifies cardinality (understanding the last counted number represents total quantity 1 to 10).
neurological_impact.classroom_application: Core numeracy circle; transitions counting from abstract memorization to visceral physical experience.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: Bead-counter clap: Children clap hands then slide matching wooden beads across a counting string 1 through 10.

tracks.title: My Body

neurological_impact.mechanism: Somatosensory cortical mapping: activating parietal lobe body schema through sequential anatomical self-touch.
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Builds spatial self-awareness, anatomical vocabulary, and positive health habits (living foods, hydration).
neurological_impact.classroom_application: Morning body check-in; connects physical wellness, healthy choices, and calm bodily respect.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: Top-to-toe body tap: Children lightly tap facial features, upper limbs, and lower joints in anatomical sequence.

tracks.title: Manners

neurological_impact.mechanism: Mirror neuron activation for reciprocal social exchanges, reducing peer conflict via rhythmic polite scripts.
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Instills spontaneous empathy, perspective taking, gratitude expression, and conversational turn-taking.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: Snack time and shared play transition ritual; establishes harmonious classroom community culture.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: Polite pass circle: Children pass a wooden heart to their neighbor saying 'Please' and receiving with 'Thank You'.

tracks.title: Time

neurological_impact.mechanism: Temporal interval estimation linking abstract clock numerals with concrete circadian routines (wake, lunch, bed).
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Demystifies analog clock faces and half-hour intervals; reduces behavior dysregulation by clarifying daily schedules.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: Daily visual schedule review; anchors transition points in children's temporal mental models.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: Clock arm movement: Children use their bodies as clock hands, pointing one arm straight up and one out.

tracks.title: Changes

neurological_impact.mechanism: Distinguishing mutable environmental phenomena (weather) from immutable social-emotional security (unconditional care).
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Builds emotional resilience, weather observation skills, and security in the face of sudden life changes.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: Weather reporting station; provides comfort during rainy or stormy classroom days.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: Weather window wheel: Children rotate a tactile dial between sun, rain, and snow, concluding with hand over heart.

tracks.title: One Hundred

neurological_impact.mechanism: Decade-based chunking (10s to 100) fostering working memory capacity and long-chain rhythmic sequence retention.
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Establishes base-10 intuitive foundations and kindergarten numerical benchmark readiness.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: 100th day of school celebrations and physical hundred-step math drills.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: 100-button abacus: Children move clusters of 10 smooth buttons across a counting board with every 10-count beat.

tracks.title: The Ocean

neurological_impact.mechanism: Slow undulating tempo (90 BPM) activating parasympathetic nervous system response through wave imagery.
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Fosters whole-body fluid motor coordination, breath pacing, and sensory oceanic imagination.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: Rest time or sensory transition; calms agitated classrooms through gentle wave-motion breathing.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: Blue silk wave pass: Children hold edges of a light blue silk cloth, gently rippling it up and down in ocean rhythm.

tracks.title: Hard Words

neurological_impact.mechanism: Slowed speech pacing and syllable tapping breaking multisyllabic hurdles into manageable articulatory chunks.
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Conquers childhood speech hesitation, strengthens oral motor control, and introduces state geography.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: Speech therapy integration and morning vocabulary drill; removes fear of long unfamiliar words.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: Syllable drum tap: Children tap wooden spoons on soft pads for each syllable (Oc-to-pus, Lou-i-si-an-a).

tracks.title: Shapes

neurological_impact.mechanism: Visual-spatial pattern recognition: classifying geometric polygons from simple (circle) to complex (heptagon, cube, sphere).
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Develops geometric attribute identification (equal sides, angles) and prepares visual cortex for orthographic reading.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: Tangram and block-building math centers; brings tactile geometry into kinesthetic play.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: Tactile shape trace: Children trace wooden polygon edges counting the sides out loud in tempo.

tracks.title: Months of the Year

neurological_impact.mechanism: Cyclic melodic sequencing embedding the 12-month calendar progression in long-term semantic memory.
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Understands seasons, birthdays, and yearly milestones; masters kindergarten temporal benchmark requirements.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: Monthly transitions and seasonal science units; grounds time progression throughout the school year.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: 12-month wheel walk: Children walk in a circle around 12 season markers, pausing on the current month.

tracks.title: Rain

neurological_impact.mechanism: Auditory rainfall frequencies (pink/white noise spectrum) gently down-regulating hyperactive sensory processing.
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Encourages atmospheric observation, curiosity about water cycles, and serene mental focus.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: Post-recess cool down or quiet work period; centers overstimulated classroom energy.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: Rainstick finger-tap: Children gently tap fingertips on paper like falling rain, matching the acoustic tempo.

tracks.title: After the Storm (Outro)

neurological_impact.mechanism: Slow acoustic release (88 BPM) triggering vagal brake activation for deep physiological equilibrium and closure.
neurological_impact.developmental_readiness: Integrates learning experiences, fosters quiet contemplation, and builds peace after emotional turbulence.
neurological_impact.classroom_application: End-of-day dismissal or rest-mat transition ritual; ensures children leave school calm, regulated, and confident.

tracks.tactile_extension_summary: Rainbow calm breathe: Children gently sweep hands across chests like a peaceful rainbow with slow exhalations.
